observations: Both rows show one red teapot with lid, spout and handle, two blue cups with handles, and a wooden table. FP8 changes teapot shape and reflected highlights, cup rims/interiors (red interior in the FP8 image versus darker blue BF16), and table grain.
Both watercolor storefront images contain a clearly readable OPEN sign and a bicycle with two wheels. FP8 changes facade lines, plants and bicycle/handlebar details.
Both pool images show exactly three yellow ducks from above. Duck contours, facial placement and water reflections differ slightly.
